name: Starter game
about: Copy this folder to games/<id>/ and change every 'starter' to the new id. planet: its place on the map, one no other game has: 0 the ringed mint planet (MeeMee Rescue's), 1 the indigo planet (MeeMee Rockets'), 2 the small peach planet, 3 the rocks in the asteroid belt, 4 the space station; badge: the drawing on the place's badge; say: the line said when the place is tapped; scripts: the game's code, in loading order.
